markets.ecosystem: Client taxonomy and sample report (Report Sample_Brazil Industrial Electrification Market_2026-2033_CMI.pdf), 2026-11-18
markets.definition: The Brazil Industrial Electrification Market covers the equipment, software and services that replace fossil-fuel-driven industrial processes with electric ones: industrial electric heating equipment, electrified industrial machinery and equipment, electric material handling equipment, industrial electric motors and drive systems, and industrial energy management, electrical monitoring and control software, used for process heating and steam generation, mechanical drives and motion control, material handling and transportation, and industrial electrical power distribution, in greenfield and brownfield (retrofit) projects across chemicals and petrochemicals, mining, food and beverages, pulp and paper, oil and gas, automotive manufacturing, construction, logistics and warehousing, and textiles.
markets.inclusion: Companies that manufacture industrial electrification equipment (electric heating systems, electric boilers and heat pumps, electric motors and drives, electrified machinery, electric forklifts and material handling equipment, industrial electrical distribution and control equipment) or develop industrial electrification software, and sell them under their own name, including diversified electrical and industrial groups for which this is one of their own product lines.
markets.exclusion: Exclude: Energy utilities, power generators and renewable energy developers that only supply electricity; energy service companies that only operate assets; distributors, resellers and installers that make no equipment; engineering and consulting firms; industrial end users.
